decision.rationale: TXN-008089 is on card CRD-000158. It posted on 2026-10-07 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 17 days later, so it is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount is 37950 cents (379.50 EUR). Authorisation AUTH-008280 is for the same 37950 cents: an e-commerce payment, 3-D Secure authenticated, CVV matched and approved. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder says the quote was 235.29 EUR, which would leave a difference of 14421 cents. But the cardholder also says they do not have the quote, and an amount the cardholder states is a claim, not evidence. With no receipt and the posted amount equal to the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. Under amount-no-receipt, the next step is to ask the merchant for the receipt or order details.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt or order details for the purchase of 379.50 EUR made on 2026-10-06. They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to pay, including any quote given before the order.
